extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to the Bread Loaf Writers' Conference (writers seeking to attend)
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative dates, fees, and payment/notification procedures for applicants and participants in the 2026 Bread Loaf Writers' Conference. Covers deadlines, costs, notification timing, and refund/payment policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference dates
rubrics_metrics.description: The 2026 Bread Loaf Writers’ Conference will be held from Wednesday, August 12 to Saturday, August 22 in Ripton, Vermont.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: All applications are due by March 15.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are strongly encouraged to apply early.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant total fee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fee is a bundled total covering tuition and room & board; specific breakdowns are provided for transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial aid and scholarships
rubrics_metrics.description: See Application Information for descriptions of financial aid and scholarship categories and amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the Application Information page for eligibility, categories, and award amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance notification timing and method
rubrics_metrics.description: Notification letters will be sent via Submittable in late May.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers/notifications are delivered through the Submittable platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirmation and fee payment timing
rubrics_metrics.description: A confirmation form to hold your spot is due soon after notification of acceptance, and the conference fees are due in July.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepted applicants must return a confirmation form to reserve their place; final fees are due by the July deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment before arrival requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All participants must pay in full before arriving on campus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Full payment is a condition of attendance; partial or unpaid balances are not permitted on arrival.

rubrics_metrics.name: No-refund policy for early departure
rubrics_metrics.description: No refund of fees will be made for participants who must leave the conference early.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants who depart early for any reason are not eligible for any refund of the conference fees.
